Politics · World

Israel strikes Lebanon; West Bank raids and wildfire also reported

Israeli military strikes targeted southern Lebanon, including the town of Mansouri, following an evacuation warning. Lebanon's health ministry reported one person killed and 11 wounded in these strikes, described by the Israeli military as a response to a Hezbollah ceasefire violation. The strikes were among the deadliest since a June ceasefire. Separately, Israeli forces conducted raids in the occupied West Bank's Qalandiya refugee camp, detaining Palestinians. In another incident, crews battled a wildfire that shut down major highways in Israel. Meanwhile, Israel approved funding to seize occupied West Bank sites.
